args.evidence: The failing test assert_daily_revenue_one_row_per_region expects exactly one row per (order_date, region_name). The current fct_daily_revenue model groups by order_date, region_name, priority, producing multiple rows per region per day (one per priority). This caused 3659 duplicate rows, failing the test. Removing priority from the GROUP BY (and SELECT) fixes the duplication.

patch.sql:

    order_date,
    region_name,
    count(*) as orders,
    sum(net_revenue) as net_revenue
from {{ ref('fct_orders') }}
group by order_date, region_name
